evaluationPolicy.method: Semantic criteria, not exact-match/keyword-only scoring. The file is an editorial specification, not executable AI scoring.
evaluationPolicy.incomplete: Identify missing meaning and ask for clarification before advancing.
evaluationPolicy.unsupported: Do not invent facts beyond the current dialogue prefix.
evaluationPolicy.asrUncertain: Request repetition or text editing; no care penalty from uncertain recognition.
evaluationPolicy.feedback: Mention achieved meaning, one point to repair, a hint, then retry.
evaluationPolicy.pronunciation: not assessed without verified audio implementation
